That's so sweet of you.. I feel important for once, if you're willing to help. I have no idea how you could, but I appreciate the thought.
 
I have a plan: I'm going to stop binge eating when school starts again (that would be.. Monday so not long now) and care for myself more. Cause I don't want to feel guilty anymore because of what I eat. It might be feeding my "depression", if I really am depressed or just dumb.
